description: Add Battle AI admin management tab to the admin page and ensure all admin functions are complete. The admin.tsx already has tabs for users, plans, roles, announcements, landing, etc. Add a new 'Battle AI' tab with full configuration: manage available avatars, set pricing per session, configure plan restrictions, view all sessions, enable/disable the feature. Also verify all existing admin tabs are properly connected.
steps: 1. Read the full admin.tsx file to understand the existing tab structure and patterns used

2. Add a new tab 'Battle AI' to the admin page in artifacts/creatools/src/pages/admin.tsx. The tab should include: (a) Enable/disable toggle for the entire Battle AI feature, (b) Available avatars list with add/edit/remove (each avatar has: id, name, previewUrl, voiceId, gender, description), (c) Price per session input (number), (d) Plan restrictions - which plans can use Battle AI (checkboxes for free/basic/pro), (e) Max session duration slider (minutes), (f) Sessions list showing all user sessions with status, user info, timestamps, and ability to force-stop

3. Wire the admin tab to call the backend endpoints: GET /api/battle-ai/admin/config, PUT /api/battle-ai/admin/config, GET /api/battle-ai/admin/sessions. Use the authFetch pattern from existing admin tabs.

4. Ensure the AI Assistant admin section (already exists in admin.tsx) is properly visible and functional - verify it has the config panel with system prompt, personality name, plan limits, enable/disable, and conversations viewer
acceptance_criteria: Admin page has a 'Battle AI' tab that renders configuration controls
Admin can toggle Battle AI feature on/off
Admin can manage available avatars list
Admin can set pricing and plan restrictions
Admin can view all Battle AI sessions
pnpm run build succeeds without type errors
verification: Run pnpm run typecheck from workspace root and confirm no errors
Run pnpm run build from workspace root and confirm successful build
